campaigns.title: The trigger list is read from PRINCIPLES.md's table, and only from its table

mutants.breaks: any `T-` token anywhere in PRINCIPLES.md becomes a trigger, so a paragraph mentioning one in passing invents a requirement nobody agreed and every design is then unaccounted for it

campaigns.title: A design must name every trigger, not at least one

mutants.breaks: a trigger nobody mentioned is never reported, so a design passes by naming one trigger and stopping -- the guard-that-barely-fails shape this check exists to remove

campaigns.title: A fired trigger carries what was settled

mutants.breaks: `T-SPEND: fired` with nothing after it is accepted, so the section becomes a checklist of ticked boxes and stops being evidence that anything was settled

campaigns.title: One problem reports as one problem

mutants.old: if not any(trigger in reason for reason in reasons):
mutants.breaks: a trigger already reported for an unreadable line is reported a second time as `not mentioned`, so one defect reads as two and the output overstates what is wrong

campaigns.title: A ratchet nobody can read is not a ratchet

mutants.old:
except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return True
mutants.new:
except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return False
mutants.breaks: a deleted or corrupt baseline reads as green, so the gate reports a pass for a comparison it never made -- the stale-verdict shape this repo has already been burned by twice

campaigns.title: The stub exemption cannot swallow a real design

mutants.breaks: every design is treated as un-designed, so the check reports nothing and the ratchet holds at whatever it last recorded -- the gate is switched off while still printing a pass
